vocabulary.meaning_en: hot food that is cooked and served very quickly
vocabulary.example: We sometimes eat fast food on Fridays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a burger with cheese on the meat
vocabulary.example: Can I have a cheeseburger, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a round piece of cooked meat in a bread roll
long thin pieces of fried potato
vocabulary.example: I want fries with my burger.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a burger with fries and a drink together, for one price
vocabulary.note_en: Also called "a meal" or "a meal deal".

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you drink, like water or juice

vocabulary.example: Can I have a large cola, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a cold sweet food made from milk
vocabulary.example: One small chocolate ice cream, please.
The total is nine dollars and fifty cents.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a bank card you use to pay
vocabulary.example: I want to pay with my credit card.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a paper that shows what you paid
vocabulary.example: Thank you. Here is your receipt.
Please wait over there for your food.

vocabulary.meaning_en: ask for food or drink in a restaurant
vocabulary.example: What would you like to order today?

fine_lines.title: Can I have vs I want
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Can I have ...? سؤال مهذب. I want ... أكثر مباشرة، وهي مقبولة في المطاعم السريعة لكن الأفضل أن تضيف please.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Can I have ...?" is a polite question. "I want ..." is more direct; add "please" to sound polite.

examples.sentence: Can I have a cola, please?
I want the combo meal, please.

fine_lines.title: for here vs to go
fine_lines.explanation_ar: for here = تأكل داخل المطعم. to go = تأخذ الطعام معك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "For here" = eat in the restaurant. "To go" = take the food away.

examples.sentence: For here, please. I want to eat here.
To go, please. I'll eat at home.

expressions.phrase: What would you like to order today?
expressions.meaning_en: The worker asks for your order.
expressions.example: Hi! What would you like to order today?

expressions.phrase: Can I have a cheeseburger, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الحصول على برغر بالجبن من فضلك؟
expressions.example: Can I have a chicken sandwich, please?

expressions.phrase: Would you like a meal with fries and a drink?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تريد وجبة مع بطاطس ومشروب؟
expressions.example: Would you like a meal with that?
Anything else for you today? No, thanks.

expressions.phrase: Is that all? / Yes, that's all.
expressions.meaning_ar: هل هذا كل شيء؟ / نعم، هذا كل شيء.
expressions.example: Is that all for your order? Yes, that's all.
How much is it? It's six dollars.

expressions.meaning_en: Will you eat here or take it away?
expressions.example: For here or to go? For here, please.

expressions.phrase: How would you like to pay?
expressions.example: How would you like to pay? By card.

expressions.phrase: Please wait over there for your food.
expressions.meaning_ar: من فضلك انتظر هناك من أجل طعامك.
expressions.example: Please wait over there. It will be ready soon.

expressions.phrase: It will be ready in three minutes.
expressions.meaning_en: Telling you how long to wait.
expressions.example: Your order will be ready in five minutes.

grammar.title: Saying prices
grammar.explanation_ar: نقرأ السعر هكذا: $9.50 = nine dollars and fifty cents، أو بشكل أقصر: nine fifty.
grammar.explanation_en: Say $9.50 as "nine dollars and fifty cents" or "nine fifty".

grammar.title: Future with will
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم will + الفعل الأساسي للحديث عن المستقبل: It will be ready.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "will" + base verb for the future.
examples: It will be ready in three minutes.

questions.question: A combo meal usually has ...
choices: a burger, fries and a drink
questions.explanation_en: A combo has a burger, fries and a drink.

questions.question: How do we say $9.50?
questions.explanation_ar: نقول nine dollars and fifty cents.
questions.explanation_en: We say "nine dollars and fifty cents".

questions.question: "For here or to go?" "For here, please." The customer will ...
questions.explanation_ar: For here تعني يأكل في المطعم.
questions.explanation_en: "For here" means eat in the restaurant.

questions.question: Choose the polite order:
choices: Can I have a large cola, please?

questions.question: It ____ ready in three minutes.
questions.explanation_ar: نقول will be (will ثم الفعل الأساسي).

questions.question: "How would you like to pay?" "____"
questions.explanation_en: The question is about how you pay.

questions.question: "Thank you very much." "____"
questions.explanation_ar: الرد على الشكر: You are welcome.
